title: Damian Lillard goes off for 40 in Blazers' win vs. Wizards | NBA on ESPN
description:
Damian Lillard leads the charge in D.C. Sunday night as the Portland Trail Blazers defeat the Washington Wizards 119-109. Dame tallied 40 points on 12-for-29 shooting, 7 rebounds, 5 assists, and chipped in 13 free throws as Rip City improves to 10-5 on the early season.
